statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail has eased below the block threshold because the prior U.S. trend closed off its high and fresh post-maintenance NQ continuation is not independently verified; Stress remains extreme ahead of Friday payrolls.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH. The next material escalation test is whether post-payroll price discovery develops persistent extension with shallow or failed retracements; orderly two-sided trade would support lower Tail.
headline: Tail eases to WATCH after the strong U.S. close; payrolls define the next major risk window
body: September NQ ended near 29,502.25 after a 29,584.25 session high and a 29,207 open. The Nasdaq Composite gained 1.40%, VIX finished near 14.32, and fresh supplementary Finviz context showed 7 of 8 tracked megacaps positive but mixed semiconductor confirmation. Immediate post-maintenance NQ structure is not independently verified, so Tail is 24% while Stress stays at 100% ahead of payrolls and amid elevated Middle East oil risk.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 hours, Tail was mostly low through Europe, rose to WATCH around the U.S. event/opening window, and became elevated late in the technology-led rally as NQ held near session highs. The 22:00 UTC September 2 slot had no published ChatGPT assessment and remains unavailable.
outlookSummary: Current Tail is back at WATCH because no fresh post-maintenance continuation is independently verified. Overnight Tail is expected to normalize absent renewed directional efficiency. Friday payrolls keeps Stress extreme; any post-release elevated Tail is explicitly conditional on observed persistent extension, failed retracements or session-extreme holding.

forecast.analysis: NQ ended the prior session at 29,502.25 after reaching 29,584.25, so the late rally did retrace from its extreme. Fresh post-maintenance NQ structure is not independently verified; Tail therefore eases to WATCH while payroll and Middle East risk keep Stress extreme.
drivers: Prior NQ rally closed off the session high
Post-maintenance NQ structure is not independently verified
Fresh Finviz context shows 7 of 8 megacaps positive
Friday Employment Situation is due at 12:30 UTC

news.title: Wall Street ends sharply higher as Waller remarks ease rate hike fears

forecast.analysis: During the first full overnight hour, Tail stays at WATCH unless the reopened market resumes persistent extension with shallow pullbacks. A broader two-sided rotation would confirm normalization from the prior U.S. trend.
drivers: Prior cash-session technology strength remains background context
Payroll risk remains ahead, not yet observed as price path

forecast.analysis: The prior U.S. impulse is expected to age further. Conditional Tail rises only if countertrend moves fail repeatedly; otherwise overnight liquidity and distance from the cash close favor a more mixed structure.
Absent renewed one-way efficiency, Tail remains WATCH but edges lower as the overnight session progresses. Repeated high retests with weak pullbacks would invalidate that normalization.
drivers: Repeated failed pullbacks would raise Tail
No future continuation is treated as observed

forecast.analysis: Tail holds at the bottom of WATCH. The main conditional test is whether overnight counter-swings remain meaningful; persistent extension without retracement would keep the prior trend mechanically relevant.
By 03:00 UTC the base case moves below WATCH if no new one-way structure has emerged. Stress remains high because payroll is approaching, but event importance alone does not establish Tail.
drivers: Payroll approaches without being treated as Tail proof

forecast.analysis: Lower-liquidity Asian trade keeps Tail low in the base case. A new directional leg would require independent confirmation through shallow retracements and sustained extension before Tail rises.
drivers: Fresh directional confirmation would be required

forecast.analysis: Tail stays low if the overnight session continues to rotate. The prior U.S. rally remains context, but without fresh high-holding or repeated failed retracements it is not carried forward as observed structure.
drivers: Prior U.S. rally is contextual, not current-path proof
Payroll remains the dominant scheduled risk

forecast.analysis: As Europe approaches, Tail remains low unless a directional move begins to survive counter-swings. Stress stays high because the payroll release is now closer, while the path remains the deciding Tail variable.
drivers: Payroll proximity raises Stress more than Tail

forecast.analysis: The Europe open can restore liquidity and expose whether overnight positioning is directional or balanced. Tail stays low unless price holds extremes and retracements repeatedly fail.
drivers: Successful retracements would keep Tail low

forecast.analysis: Tail returns to WATCH as European participation and U.S. premarket positioning overlap. The score reflects a larger risk window, not an assumption that a directional move has already formed.
Premarket event sensitivity increases. Tail remains WATCH because the payroll result is still unknown; only subsequently observed directional efficiency could justify an elevated state.
drivers: Event uncertainty raises Stress before Tail

forecast.analysis: The final two hours before payroll keep Tail at WATCH and Stress near maximum. A widening range alone would not imply mean-reversion failure; persistent extension would need to be observed after the release.
drivers: Payroll release is two hours away

forecast.analysis: One hour before payroll, Tail remains WATCH despite extreme Stress. The release is a catalyst, not proof of a pathological path; any forecast escalation is conditional on post-release structure.
drivers: Employment Situation is one hour away
Stress is near maximum before the release
Post-release price structure will determine Tail

forecast.analysis: The 12:00 UTC slot contains the 12:30 Employment Situation release. Tail is capped at WATCH before the print; immediate post-release extension, retracement depth and cross-asset confirmation become the key conditional checks.

After payroll, elevated Tail is conditional on a verified directional repricing that survives counter-swings. If the first move retraces materially or becomes two-sided, the appropriate path would be back toward WATCH.
drivers: Failed retracements would sustain elevated Tail
Orderly two-sided price discovery would reduce Tail

forecast.analysis: The U.S. cash-open hour carries the highest conditional Tail because payroll repricing can meet opening-auction flow. The elevated score assumes only a risk window; persistent one-way structure would still need to be observed.
drivers: Observed pullbacks remain the key invalidation

forecast.analysis: The first full cash hour remains conditionally elevated if opening continuation is efficient and retracements fail. A successful counter-swing would quickly weaken the case for sustained Tail.

Tail moderates later in the U.S. morning unless a second directional leg keeps price near extremes. If post-payroll volatility decays and retracements broaden, the regime should move back toward WATCH.
Elevated Tail is kept only at the threshold for a possible delayed continuation. Two-sided midday trade would invalidate the elevated state and favor WATCH.
drivers: Midday two-sided trade would normalize Tail

forecast.analysis: By late U.S. morning the base case returns to WATCH. A renewed directional leg would need fresh evidence of shallow pullbacks or repeated extension rather than relying on the morning event alone.
drivers: Fresh extension would be required to re-elevate Tail

forecast.analysis: Afternoon Tail remains WATCH if the session has developed meaningful counter-swings. Persistent extreme-holding into the final hours would be the main condition that could keep risk higher.
The U.S. cash-close hour is forecast at WATCH absent renewed one-way efficiency. A late trend extension could delay normalization, while a balanced close would support lower Tail into the weekend.
The final futures hour before the weekly close remains WATCH primarily because liquidity can thin. Without persistent directional structure, Tail is expected to stay below the blocking threshold.
drivers: Persistent direction would be required for a block state

forecastDetail.comment: Tail eases to WATCH because the prior trend closed off its high and fresh post-maintenance continuation is not independently verified; Stress remains extreme ahead of payrolls.
WATCH persists unless the reopened overnight market resumes one-way extension with shallow pullbacks; two-sided rotation would confirm normalization.
Tail edges lower as the U.S. impulse ages; failed countertrend moves would be the main condition for renewed escalation.
Overnight normalization remains the base case unless repeated high retests and weak pullbacks re-establish directional efficiency.
Tail stays at the bottom of WATCH while meaningful counter-swings remain possible; pre-payroll positioning keeps Stress high.
The base case drops below WATCH by 03:00 UTC if no fresh one-way structure emerges; payroll remains a Stress catalyst, not Tail proof.
